presentation.summary: Sync Silo watch activity, lists, and ratings with Trakt.
presentation.description_markdown: Imports watched movies and episodes, resume progress, favorites, the watchlist, and movie and show ratings from Trakt. Exports completed plays, unwatched titles, favorites, watchlist changes, and ratings, and forwards live playback start, pause, and stop events.
presentation.setup_markdown: Create an API app at [trakt.tv/oauth/applications](https://trakt.tv/oauth/applications) with the redirect URI `urn:ietf:wg:oauth:2.0:oob`, then enter its client ID and client secret below. Each Silo profile then connects its own Trakt account from its watch-provider settings by entering a code at trakt.tv/activate.
